speaker: josias_thwaite
text: St Peter, and a hot morning for him. The parish has sat through it, which is more than the streets did on Friday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We sat, Master Thwaite. The pew does not require a commentary on the way out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good morrow, sir. It was a short gospel, and the heat was the longer sermon.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The heat is not in my gift, Master Shakespeare. The heads were three, and three is enough when men are already counting doors.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three is a merciful number, sir.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse, your heel. You have brought the lane in with you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is dust, Mistress, not mud. Dust will not wait on the mat.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will brush it at the house. The flags here are too clean to take the blame.

speaker: (a man at the porch)
text: You, the weaver. You're none of this parish. Where were you born, that you stand in it?

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Norwich, sir. I have always had a Norwich face, and a loom in Bishopsgate.

speaker: (a man at the porch)
text: Norwich is a long way to come for a sermon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He came for his dinner and stayed for his work. The sermon he may have. The questions he need not.

speaker: (a man at the porch)
text: Keep him indoors after dark, mistress. Friday's timber is still in men's mouths.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Friday is two days behind the door, sir. Today is Peter, and a hot one.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Sir John goes to his own door and speaks to no one. Let that be the fashion of the morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had not meant to break it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not. Gillis, walk on my left. Alse, on my right. Master Shakespeare may come behind, if he can do it without a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Behind is my best part today, Mistress.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib will be on the Golding again. I moved him before church. He will have gone back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the book is in good hands, and better paws.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not praise the cat for sitting a book you will want after dinner. I am carrying the keys, and I will not carry a proverb as well.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And tomorrow, Master Shakespeare? Does the Theatre open, with the Mayor's letter still wet?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We meet in the morning and see what the morning is. I have not heard an order that shuts the door.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then hear mine. Home, and the front windows shut if the afternoon stays this still. I did not let you the weather.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will be at the loom. A loom is a small noise, and it stays in the back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay in the back, Gillis. The close is full of men who like a question.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: God keep this house, Mistress Ansell. Three heads were enough. I shall not add a fourth on the flags.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are well matched, sir. Come.
